title: Zero Forcing in Generalized Petersen Graphs
headline: An independent Lean 4 formalisation and Palomar-verified route to $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge 13$, archived after prior-art review.
description: This project establishes $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every integer $n\ge 13$ via an audited proof architecture, reproducible computational certificates and a complete Lean 4 formalisation. The registered snapshot passed Palomar verification. A later prior-art audit identified an earlier public proof and an earlier independent Lean formalisation, so this repository is retained as an alternative verification route rather than a novelty or priority claim.
verification: Mathematical proof audit passed; the Lean 4 formalisation is complete and passed its final kernel/transitive-axiom audit; Palomar verification passed and the immutable snapshot is registered as PALOMAR-2026-09-27-000004 v1.
attribution: The corrected target appears as Conjecture 5 in Arnav Krishnan's July 2026 preprint. John Fairfax-Ball's contribution is an alternative proof and verification architecture, computational certification and an independent Lean 4 formalisation. Prior-art review found an earlier public proof by txmy and an earlier independent Lean formalisation by TrueTuring, so no first-proof, first-formalisation, novelty or publication-priority claim is made.
original_source: Arnav Krishnan, “A correction to the Zero Forcing Number of the Generalized Petersen Graphs P(n,3)”, arXiv:2607.19412v1 (2026), Conjecture 5. Prior-art review subsequently located an earlier public proof package by txmy.
